feature.name: Check a plan before writing
feature.description: Applies proposed upserts and deletes to a copy of the model and reports only the errors the plan introduces.

requirements.text: Only errors introduced by the plan make ok false; existing problems are reported separately

acceptance.given: a plan with a workflow step that does not exist
acceptance.then: ok is false, introduced has unknown_feature, no file changed

decisions.decision: Plan checks apply changes to a copy of the snapshot
decisions.reason: One validation for real and planned state; no second implementation
